results.name: Bildstock
results.description:
The wayside shrine stands on the extended Autobahnweg near Mannswörth, in the immediate vicinity of the A4 East Highway. In local descriptions, it is referred to as the “wayside shrine next to the East Highway” or as a brick wayside shrine on the Autobahnweg. Today’s Autobahnweg follows an older road that was originally known as Südrandstraße.

The small monument consists of a slender pillar built of red bricks on a solid concrete base. Above it is a wider, house-like structure with a gabled roof and a glass-enclosed prayer niche. A lantern and flowers at the base indicate that the wayside shrine is still being maintained.

No reliable information is currently available regarding the date of construction, the donor, or the reason for its erection. The architectural style could suggest the late 19th or early 20th century; however, it is also possible that an older wayside shrine was renovated at a later date.

    Multiple intersection nodes for complex traffic routing.

    Clean, low-poly geometry optimized for real-time rendering and game engines.

    Flat terrain base, ready to be populated with buildings and props.**

results.name: Cullen House from Twilight (+Skp Download Link)
results.description: I watched the Twilight films for the first time and noticed that the house design changed throughout the movies, especially the back section. Curious about this, I started looking for original set plans from Celtic Film Studios and found out that the first film was actually shot at the real Hoke House in Portland. However, for the sequels — particularly Breaking Dawn — a replica set was built, which resulted in noticeable design changes, especially at the back and on the east side. In fact, the entire rear section underwent major modifications. For example, the large concrete pillar was replaced with three separate supports, giving the house a significantly different appearance. Here is a link for the Full Texturered Sketchup model:https://drive.google.com/file/d/1WWnNfXKvAq8mTWRPN1Npgdxuh2unjo3d/view?usp=sharing

results.name: Phiphitphakdi Residence, Sai Buri, Thailand
results.description:
Phiphitphakdi Residence (MAHS-THA-PTN-SAB-TAL-S-002-F-0001) is a wooden-concrete residential building in Sai Buri, Pattani, raised on high brick pillars. The two-story rectangular plan includes a rounded western porch and an eastern curved staircase with red-painted steps. White wooden walls have long timber-framed casement windows with vegetal-carved panels above. Inside are halls, rooms, stairwell, dining area, veranda, balconies, and two upper bedrooms. Its cement-tiled hip-and-gable roof, carved air vents, and Malay, Javanese, and Western decorative influences define the residence.

results.name: Ko Lanta Community Musuem, Krabi, Thailand
results.description:
This raised two-story wooden building (MAHS-THA-KBI-KOL-KLY-S-001-F-0001) blends local and colonial architectural elements in a rectangular plan. The upper structure rests on concrete pillars, while wooden columns support the roof. A double wooden staircase leads to a wide veranda facing a seafront courtyard. Double-paned windows, doors, and perimeter vents improve airflow. The hip and porch gable roofs are clad with cement tiles. A Garuda emblem, museum sign, 2007 date, antique district office sign, tiled ground floor, and wooden upper floor remain.

results.name: Sai Buri Governor’s Residence, Pattani, Thailand
results.description:
This large raised wooden residence (MAHS-THA-PTN-SAB-TAL-S-003-F-0001) stands on brick pillars and follows an L-shaped plan, with a two-story rear wing aligned east-west. A front stair leads to the verandah, partly enclosed by carved woodwork. Walls combine original timber planks and later galvanized sheets, with timber casement windows, vegetal carvings, and ventilated eaves. Inside, rooms connect to an open hallway, kitchen, courtyard, and well. The roof mixes terracotta and corrugated tiles, while carved metal ridge ornaments highlight the house’s historic domestic character.
